# Visual Architecture & Flows

## 1. End-to-End Content Pipeline

```{mermaid}
graph TB
    START["🚀 /social-generate Command<br/>Input: Idea, Variations, Platform List"]

    START --> PHASE1["PHASE 1: Research & Ideation<br/>Subcommand: /social-ideate"]

    PHASE1 --> TREND["Agent: Trend-Researcher<br/>Find: Hashtags, formats, hooks"]
    PHASE1 --> IDEATE["Agent: Content-Ideator<br/>Create: Platform angles"]

    TREND -.parallelProcess.-> IDEATE

    IDEATE --> POLICY["🪝 HOOK: Content-Policy-Check<br/>Validate: Brand safety, compliance"]

    POLICY -->|PASS| PHASE2["PHASE 2: Multi-Platform Generation<br/>Subcommand: /social-create"]
    POLICY -->|FAIL| REVIEW["⚠️ Manual Review Required"]

    PHASE2 --> TW["Agent: Twitter-Creator<br/>Output: Threads, polls, tweets"]
    PHASE2 --> LI["Agent: LinkedIn-Creator<br/>Output: Stories, carousels"]
    PHASE2 --> IG["Agent: Instagram-Creator<br/>Output: Posts, stories, reels"]
    PHASE2 --> FB["Agent: Facebook-Creator<br/>Output: Questions, polls"]
    PHASE2 --> TK["Agent: TikTok-Creator<br/>Output: Video scripts"]
    PHASE2 --> VIS["Agent: Visual-Generator<br/>Output: Images, graphics"]

    TW -.parallel.-> LI
    LI -.parallel.-> IG
    IG -.parallel.-> FB
    FB -.parallel.-> TK
    TK -.parallel.-> VIS

    TW --> VISUAL_CHECK["🪝 HOOK: Visual-Validation<br/>Check: Dimensions, file size, brand"]
    LI --> VISUAL_CHECK
    IG --> VISUAL_CHECK
    FB --> VISUAL_CHECK
    TK --> VISUAL_CHECK
    VIS --> VISUAL_CHECK

    VISUAL_CHECK -->|PASS| PHASE3["PHASE 3: Scheduling & Publishing<br/>Subcommand: /social-schedule"]
    VISUAL_CHECK -->|FAIL| REVIEW

    PHASE3 --> SCHED["Agent: Scheduler<br/>Determine: Optimal times per platform"]

    SCHED --> PUBLISH["Agent: Multi-Publisher<br/>Publish: To all platforms via APIs"]

    PUBLISH --> OUTPUT["✅ Final Output<br/>📤 Posted or scheduled<br/>📊 Analytics tracking enabled<br/>🎨 Visuals delivered"]

    REVIEW --> END["🔄 Return for manual adjustment"]
    OUTPUT --> END

    style START fill:#4ecdc4,color:#fff
    style PHASE1 fill:#ffe66d
    style PHASE2 fill:#a8dadc,stroke:#333,stroke-width:3px
    style PHASE3 fill:#f1faee
    style OUTPUT fill:#06d6d0,color:#fff
    style POLICY fill:#ff6b6b,color:#fff
    style VISUAL_CHECK fill:#ff6b6b,color:#fff
```

## 2. Platform-Specific Content Routing

```{mermaid}
graph TB
    IDEA["📝 Developed Idea<br/>(with platform angles)"]

    IDEA --> TW["🐦 TWITTER ROUTE"]
    IDEA --> LI["💼 LINKEDIN ROUTE"]
    IDEA --> IG["📸 INSTAGRAM ROUTE"]
    IDEA --> FB["👍 FACEBOOK ROUTE"]
    IDEA --> TK["🎵 TIKTOK ROUTE"]

    TW -->|280 char limit| TW_FORMAT["Threads (5-10)<br/>Polls<br/>Standalone tweets"]
    TW_FORMAT -->|2-3 hashtags| TW_STYLE["Tone: Conversational<br/>Hook: Bold statement<br/>CTA: Join community"]
    TW_STYLE --> TW_OUTPUT["✅ 3 variations<br/>Best time: 9am, 3pm"]

    LI -->|1500 char optimum| LI_FORMAT["Personal Stories<br/>Document Carousel<br/>Native Video"]
    LI_FORMAT -->|3-5 hashtags| LI_STYLE["Tone: Professional<br/>Hook: Vulnerability<br/>CTA: Connect"]
    LI_STYLE --> LI_OUTPUT["✅ 3 variations<br/>Best time: 7-8am, 12pm"]

    IG -->|150-300 char| IG_FORMAT["Feed Carousel<br/>Reel Script<br/>Story Template"]
    IG_FORMAT -->|5-10 hashtags| IG_STYLE["Tone: Aspirational<br/>Hook: Visual + caption<br/>CTA: Link in bio"]
    IG_STYLE --> IG_OUTPUT["✅ 3 variations<br/>Best time: 11am, 7pm"]

    FB -->|500-1000 char| FB_FORMAT["Question Post<br/>Story Post<br/>Poll"]
    FB_FORMAT -->|2-3 hashtags| FB_STYLE["Tone: Warm, community<br/>Hook: Relatable<br/>CTA: Drop comment"]
    FB_STYLE --> FB_OUTPUT["✅ 3 variations<br/>Best time: 1-3pm"]

    TK -->|30-60 sec| TK_FORMAT["POV Script<br/>Before/After<br/>Trend Participation"]
    TK_FORMAT -->|3-5 hashtags| TK_STYLE["Tone: Authentic<br/>Hook: First 3 sec<br/>CTA: Follow for more"]
    TK_STYLE --> TK_OUTPUT["✅ 3 variations<br/>Best time: 7-9am, 7-10pm"]

    TW_OUTPUT --> AGGREGATE["📊 Aggregate Results<br/>15+ posts with visuals"]
    LI_OUTPUT --> AGGREGATE
    IG_OUTPUT --> AGGREGATE
    FB_OUTPUT --> AGGREGATE
    TK_OUTPUT --> AGGREGATE

    style IDEA fill:#4ecdc4
    style TW fill:#b4a7d6
    style LI fill:#73a1c7
    style IG fill:#f4a460
    style FB fill:#6a94c9
    style TK fill:#7d5ba6
    style TW_OUTPUT fill:#e8d5f0
    style LI_OUTPUT fill:#d4e5f0
    style IG_OUTPUT fill:#fff5e6
    style FB_OUTPUT fill:#e6f0ff
    style TK_OUTPUT fill:#f0e6ff
    style AGGREGATE fill:#06d6d0
```

## 4. Parallel Agent Execution Model

```{mermaid}
graph LR
    START["Start<br/>T=0 min"] --> IDEA["Idea Development<br/>T=10 min<br/>2 agents"]

    IDEA -->|T=10| GEN["Content Generation<br/>T=30 min<br/>6 agents PARALLEL"]

    GEN -->|T=40| SCHEDULE["Scheduling<br/>T=50 min<br/>Sequential"]

    SCHEDULE -->|T=60| PUBLISH["Publishing<br/>T=65 min<br/>Sequential"]

    PUBLISH -->|T=65| END["Complete<br/>55 min total<br/>vs 6.75h manual"]

    style START fill:#06d6d0
    style IDEA fill:#ffe66d,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style GEN fill:#a8dadc,stroke:#333,stroke-width:3px
    style SCHEDULE fill:#f1faee,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style PUBLISH fill:#e7f6f5,stroke:#333,stroke-width:2px
    style END fill:#06d6d0,color:#fff
```

**Key Insight**: 6 agents working simultaneously compress 120 minutes of sequential work into 20 minutes.

## 5. Content Quality Gate System

```{mermaid}
graph TB
    INPUT["Content Input<br/>from Agents"]

    INPUT --> GATE1["🪝 GATE 1: Content Policy<br/>- Brand safety<br/>- Compliance check<br/>- Sensitive content<br/>- Promotional ratio"]

    GATE1 -->|Pass| GATE2["🪝 GATE 2: Visual Validation<br/>- Dimensions check<br/>- File size (<1MB)<br/>- Brand consistency<br/>- Alt text"]

    GATE2 -->|Pass| GATE3["🪝 GATE 3: Scheduling Optimization<br/>- Peak time alignment<br/>- Frequency limits<br/>- Conflict detection<br/>- Spread strategy"]

    GATE3 -->|Pass| PUBLISH_SUCCESS["✅ Ready to Publish"]

    GATE1 -->|Fail| REVIEW["⚠️ Manual Review"]
    GATE2 -->|Fail| REVIEW
    GATE3 -->|Fail| REVIEW

    REVIEW --> ADJUST["🔧 Agent Adjustment"]
    ADJUST --> GATE1

    PUBLISH_SUCCESS --> LIVE["🚀 Published to Platforms"]

    style GATE1 fill:#ff6b6b,color:#fff
    style GATE2 fill:#ff6b6b,color:#fff
    style GATE3 fill:#ff6b6b,color:#fff
    style PUBLISH_SUCCESS fill:#95e1d3
    style LIVE fill:#06d6d0,color:#fff
    style REVIEW fill:#ffe66d
    style ADJUST fill:#ffe66d
```

## 10. Ideal Posting Schedule per Platform

```{mermaid}
quadrantChart
    title "Weekly Posting Schedule Heatmap"
    x-axis Morning --> Evening
    y-axis Weekday --> Weekend

    Twitter: 0.8, 0.3
    LinkedIn: 0.7, 0.2
    Instagram: 0.6, 0.7
    Facebook: 0.5, 0.5
    TikTok: 0.75, 0.8
```

**Optimal Times**:
- **Twitter**: 9am, 12pm, 3pm, 6pm (workday breaks)
- **LinkedIn**: 7-8am, 12pm (before work, lunch)
- **Instagram**: 11am, 1pm, 7-9pm (lunch, evening)
- **Facebook**: 1-3pm (afternoon browsing)
- **TikTok**: 7-9am, 7-10pm (commute, evening)

---

## Key Architectural Principles

1. **Parallel Processing** - 6 agents run simultaneously, not sequentially
2. **Quality Gates** - Automatic validation at 3 checkpoints
3. **Native Platform Feel** - Content optimized per platform, not copy-paste
4. **Scalable Design** - Same system handles 1 or 100 posts/day
5. **Data-Driven** - Scheduling based on analytics, not guesswork
6. **Brand Consistency** - Core voice maintained across all platforms

See [Examples](./examples.qmd) for command usage and agent implementation details.
